categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: src/psbt.cpp implements core PSBT handling and SignPSBTInput used by the wallet to process and sign transactions.
categories.rationale: Fixes an interoperability bug where SignPSBTInput rejects valid 65-byte Taproot SIGHASH_ALL signatures when PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE is unset. As noted in issue #36507, this incorrectly triggers SIGHASH_MISMATCH and blocks downstream signing or finalization.
